account: From at least 16 February 2025, biodiversity.ai4good.ru hosted a public technical demo of the classifier, with a list of 25 species that includes the tiger and the snow leopard. The ITU account of June 2025 gives this address as the SBER pilot deployment. The system combines an object detector with a classifier for 25 native species. The intended workflow removes irrelevant images and supports ecological review. Further species and kinds of data are planned. No source quantifies savings in field work or any conservation outcome. No paper or field report on the system appears through October 2026, and its code is not public.
